test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 30 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest on ₹24,000 at 18% per annum for a period of 7 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.24000

Rate = 18% ; time = 7 months

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (24000 × 18 × 7)/12 × 100

⇒ Rs.2520

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.2520.**
